why: reports where rcl's file sink writes, resolved from `ROS_LOG_DIR` / `ROS_HOME` / `HOME` at runtime. Two constraints, both already decided elsewhere: no runtime environment on an embedded target (the same one that moved the domain ID to `rclc_support_init`'s parameter, RFC-0036), and no file sink to have a directory -- delivery is `PlatformSink` -> `nros_platform_log_write`, which each `nros-platform-<rtos>` implements as that RTOS's console. What a user loses: on-target log files and the env vars that place them.
